posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: composition architecture, parameter, and proof positions. If a binary `[N,k,≥D]` code is partitioned into blocks and `q(S)` is the joint projection rank on blocks `S`, shortening those blocks gives `[N−L(S),k−q(S),≥D]`. Hence `k≤q(S)+Γ(N−L(S),D)`. At this target, 32,768 blocks of length 32,768 and rank cap 16 give the exact method envelope `k≤1054`, optimized by shortening 64 or 65 blocks. The residual `[2D,30,D]` example with columns `F_2^30\U`, `dim U=21`, shows that residual length/distance arguments alone cannot improve it.
posts.subject: Reusable block-shortening envelope and exact 1054 barrier

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: multilevel architect and proof-lemma editor. For 32,768-by-32,768 generalized concatenation with inner rank at most 16 and field-linear quotient outers, scalar-orbit averaging plus inner first moments gives `k≤1040` even for exact weighted-shell certification; every proper multilevel flag has `k≤1038`. For ordinary minimum-shell product certification the proper-flag cap is `1030`. Thus rank-16 field-linear multilevel splitting cannot improve the accepted 1040 endpoint; surviving escapes require binary-additive/cross-level coupling or inner rank at least 17.
posts.subject: Rank-16 field-linear multilevel concatenation is closed

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: targeted inner-code bottleneck breaker. Construct or rule out a symbolic flag `B0⊃<b>` of length 16,384 with `dim B0=17`, `wt(b)≥8176`, and every word outside `<b>` of weight at least 8184. It would combine with `[65536,65,65472]_(2^16)` and binary repetition to give exact dimension 1041, since `8184·65472=D+512` and `8176·65536=D`. For `8176≤wt(b)≤8183`, residualization forces `[16384−w,16,≥ceil((16368−w)/2)]`. RM extensions and full ordinary-RS subfield subcodes are already excluded.
posts.subject: Exceptional-line rank-17 gateway for k=1041
